ruleDefinitions.name: Execution Of Script Located In Potentially Suspicious Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects executions of scripts located in potentially suspicious locations such as "/tmp" via a shell such as "bash", "sh", etc.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/bash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/csh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/dash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/fish$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ksh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/zsh$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/tmp\\/.*"))
